templates.label: NeurIPS 2026
templates.venue: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
templates.summary: The official neurips_2026.sty with the paper checklist. Anonymous with line numbers by default; add the final or preprint option when the time comes.

templates.label: ICML 2026
templates.summary: The official icml2026.sty and bibliography style with the example paper. Submissions are anonymous; switch to the accepted option for the camera-ready.

templates.label: ICLR 2027
templates.summary: The official ICLR style, bibliography style and math_commands.tex from the ICLR master template. Anonymous by default; uncomment \iclrfinalcopy for the camera-ready.

templates.label: TMLR
templates.summary: The official TMLR style and bibliography style from the JMLR organisation's repository, with their example paper.

templates.label: JMLR
templates.summary: A short paper on the jmlr class from CTAN, which the engine fetches on first compile. Author blocks, keywords and the JMLR bibliography style are in place.

templates.label: CVPR 2026
templates.venue: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
templates.summary: The official CVF author kit: cvpr.sty, the IEEE natbib style, sections split under sec/, and the rebuttal template. Review mode with line numbers by default.

templates.label: ICCV 2025
templates.venue: IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision
templates.summary: The official ICCV 2025 author kit (iccv.sty, sections under sec/, rebuttal template). ICCV 2027 has not published its kit yet; the format is the shared CVF one.

templates.label: ECCV 2026
templates.summary: The official ECCV 2026 kit: Springer's llncs.cls with eccv.sty for anonymous review with line numbers, and the splncs04 bibliography style.

patches.replace: % \usepackage[accsupp]{axessibility}  % Dabir: this package fails under the bundled engine; re-enable it where it compiles.
patches.why: axessibility does not load under the bundled XeTeX engine

templates.label: ACL Rolling Review
templates.venue: ACL, EMNLP, NAACL and other ACL venues
templates.summary: The official ACL style files (acl.sty, acl_natbib.bst) and the example paper from the ACL organisation's repository, shared by every ACL venue.

templates.label: IEEE Transactions
templates.summary: A short paper on IEEEtran in journal mode, fetched from CTAN by the engine on first compile, with the IEEEtran bibliography style.

templates.label: IEEE conference
templates.summary: IEEEtran in conference mode with author blocks and IEEE keywords. The class comes from CTAN on first compile.

templates.label: Springer Nature
templates.venue: Springer, BMC and Nature Portfolio journals
templates.summary: The official sn-jnl.cls (December 2024) with all eight reference styles and the sample article, set to the math and physical sciences numbered style.

patches.replace: \fbox{\rule{0pt}{4cm}\rule{0.9\textwidth}{0pt}} % Dabir: the kit's example figure is EPS, which the bundled engine cannot embed; use a PDF or PNG
patches.why: EPS figures cannot be embedded by the bundled engine

templates.label: Nature Portfolio
templates.venue: Nature and the Nature research journals
templates.summary: The same official Springer Nature kit with the documentclass set to the sn-nature reference style that Nature Portfolio journals ask for.

patches.why: Nature Portfolio journals use the sn-nature reference style

patches.replace: \fbox{\rule{0pt}{4cm}\rule{0.9\textwidth}{0pt}} % Dabir: the kit's example figure is EPS, which the bundled engine cannot embed; use a PDF or PNG
patches.why: EPS figures cannot be embedded by the bundled engine

templates.label: Springer LNCS
templates.venue: Lecture Notes in Computer Science proceedings
templates.summary: A short paper on llncs with running heads, ORCID, institutes and the splncs04 bibliography style. The class comes from CTAN on first compile.

templates.label: ACM conference
templates.summary: A short paper on acmart in sigconf mode, fetched from CTAN on first compile, with the ACM reference format.

templates.label: Elsevier article
templates.summary: A short paper on elsarticle, fetched from CTAN on first compile, with the elsarticle-num bibliography style.

templates.label: SIAM journals
templates.venue: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
templates.summary: The official siamart251216.cls, siamplain.bst and the example article with its shared front matter. Review mode with line numbers by default.

patches.prepend:
% Dabir: the SIAM class assumes pdfLaTeX; under the bundled XeTeX engine take its pdf branch and tell hyperref and graphicx which engine this really is.
\RequirePackage{iftex}\ifXeTeX\PassOptionsToPackage{xetex}{hyperref}\PassOptionsToPackage{xetex}{graphicx}\let\ifpdf\iftrue\fi
patches.why: the SIAM class only compiles under pdfLaTeX or dvips without this prelude

patches.replace: \label{fig:a}\fbox{\rule{0pt}{4cm}\rule{5cm}{0pt}} % Dabir: the kit's example figure is EPS, which the bundled engine cannot embed; use a PDF or PNG
patches.why: EPS figures cannot be embedded by the bundled engine

templates.label: AMS article
templates.summary: A short paper on amsart with theorem environments, subject classification and the amsplain bibliography style.

templates.label: APS Physical Review
templates.summary: A two-column letter on revtex4-2 with the aps and prl options, affiliations and acknowledgments. The class comes from CTAN on first compile; change prl to pra, prb, prd or prx.

templates.label: Plain article
templates.summary: The standard article class with the usual packages and a numbered bibliography. Nothing to fetch.

templates.label: Typst article
templates.summary: A plain Typst paper: title block, abstract, numbered sections and a bibliography from refs.bib.

templates.label: IEEE (Typst)
templates.summary: The charged-ieee template from Typst Universe (MIT-0), the two-column IEEE look with author blocks and index terms.

templates.label: NeurIPS (Typst)
templates.summary: The bloated-neurips template from Typst Universe (MIT), a community reproduction of the NeurIPS style with the checklist and an appendix. Not accepted for submission; the conference requires its LaTeX style.

templates.label: ICML (Typst)
templates.summary: The lucky-icml template from Typst Universe (MIT), a community reproduction of the ICML style. Not accepted for submission; the conference requires its LaTeX style.

templates.label: Mathematics paper (Typst)
templates.summary: The clean-math-paper template from Typst Universe (MIT): theorem environments, numbered equations and a bibliography.

templates.label: arXiv preprint (Typst)
templates.summary: The arkheion template from Typst Universe (MIT), which reproduces the common arXiv preprint look.
